incdec-sign-of-fprime.alt: Top: f(x) = x cubed minus 3x. Bottom, on the same x-scale: f'(x) = 3x squared minus 3. Where f' is above the x-axis (x < -1 and x > 1) f is increasing; where f' is below the axis (-1 < x < 1) f is decreasing. Dashed lines at x = -1 and 1 join the zeros of f' to the turning points of f.
